observation_indicators.observable_fil: Naipapangalan at naipapaliwanag ang anim na kategorya gamit ang listahan; naihihiwalay ang katayuan/rehistrasyon at specific conditions; nakapipili ng verification sa tamang awtoridad/contact nang walang garantiya, imbentong quota o pagsisi.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Names and explains the six categories using the reference list; distinguishes status/registration and specific conditions; chooses verification with the proper authority/contact without guarantees, invented quotas or blame.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Nangangako pa rin ng awtomatikong pantay na bayad o credential-only entitlement, nag-iimbento ng quota o naninisi, o hindi maiugnay ang benepisyo sa verification.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Still promises automatic equal payment or credential-only entitlement, invents quotas or blames non-recipients, or cannot connect the benefit with verification.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tamang kategorya, shared at specific conditions, at tiyak na verification nang walang untag o pangako.
levels.kaya_na_en: Accurate categories, shared and specific conditions, and specific verification without prompts or promises.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama ang direksiyon ngunit kailangan ng untag sa kondisyon, provider o ebidensiya.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Correct direction but needs prompts for conditions, provider or evidence.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi pa maiugnay ang benepisyo sa kondisyon at verification, o nagpapatuloy ang garantiya, imbentong quota o pagsisi.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Cannot yet connect benefits with conditions and verification, or persists with guarantees, invented quotas or blame.
